title: Photo in pixels
intro: Visitors take a selfie (or pick a photo) on their phone and see it on the matrix in pixels, in a frame of the season, after a "3, 2, 1, flash!". The phone shrinks the photo to a few squares and sends only those; nothing is saved: a photo is forgotten as soon as it has been on the lights. Pick the matrix, then Save.

fields.text: Visitors may also pick no frame

fields.hint: A matrix of 32 x 32 or bigger shows faces best. Photos of people are shown in public: put up a sign, and switch the app off when you are not there.
